messages:
anna: Heads up — saw a jump in EU->US fallbacks for free-tier yesterday. Users hit higher latency but some reported lower-quality outputs from the quantized variant. Should we tweak fallback rules or surface this in the console?

raj: Can you paste a sample request and the telemetry you saw? :mag:

anna: Example prompt clipped. Model: /models/llama-2-70b-vq (quant-8k). Telemetry snapshot: route_choice=eu->us-east, probe_latency_ms=310, fallback_reason=probe_timeout, fallback_variant=quant-8k, token_cost_saved=~40%.

maria: We need to separate "latency-driven" vs "quality-driven" fallbacks. For premium tenants prefer quality even if latency increases. Propose tenant policy enum: prefer_variant_by=[latency,quality,cost].

jason: +1. Also we should show the fallback trace in the console and request tracing: quick mock payload for devs:

```
{
  "route_choice": "us-east",
  "fallback_reason": "probe_timeout",
  "fallback_variant": "quant-8k",
  "probe_latency_ms": 310
}
```

raj: API debate: do we expose fallback headers to clients? e.g. `x-redwood-fallback: quant-8k;reason=probe_timeout`. Any risk of leaking model variants to public keys?

maria: I vote no for unprivileged keys. Don't leak model internals to callers. Keep telemetry server-side and surface a sanitized badge in the console: "Served from fallback (latency)". Enterprise customers can opt into richer headers via tenant setting.

anna: UX idea: tenant config dropdown: "Fallback preference: Latency | Quality | Cost" with an override toggle "Expose fallback header" (enterprise-only). Console shows counts and a small sparkline for fallback_rate.

sre-oncall: From ops: need more telemetry metrics upstream — histogram(probe_latency_ms) by region+tenant, counter(fallback_events) by reason, gauge(% requests hitting fallback). Add alert when fallback_rate > 5% for premium tenants or > 15% for free-tier.

deploy-bot: Rolling config (routing_prefs) applied to staging at 2024-11-12T14:12Z — ID cfg-rt-4932.

raj: I'll draft tenant-level routing API: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/routing_prefs with body { "prefer": "quality|latency|cost", "expose_fallback_header": true/false }. Will open PR #2789.

anna: Great — I'll pair with design for console wireframes and add a small eval to compare quant-8k vs unquantized fallback on a sampled prompt set. :thumbsup:
